sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to FIR No.509/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Ratibad, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N),
294, 323 and 506 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 02/11/2022.

As per the prosecution, the prosecutrix lodged a compliant on 31/10/2022 that the present applicant, who is a Constable has inappropriately touched and committed rape with her under the threat of killing her sons.
She has also stated that earlier also the same thing has been done by the present applicant, but she could not make a complaint due to the threat.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
The prosecutrix is major and a consenting party all through.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the complainant as well as the counsel for State has vehemently opposed the bail application.
It is stated that earlier she could not file the compliant due to the threat given to her, however, when she was again beaten up and raped on 30/10/2022, she lodged the compliant.
It is pointed out that in 164 statement also the prosecutrix has made specific allegations against the present applicant.
It is further stated that the applicant is a Constable and repeatedly threatening the prosecutrix.

Applicant is a Constable, there is apprehension of his threatening and harassing the prosecutrix, if he is enlarged on bail, under the circumstances, looking to the allegations, no ground for bail is made out.
